title: Playing drums as a boy with Manuel Gabriel and the first paid job
summary: At eight he began on drums with old cornetist Manuel Gabriel, played excursions and house parties, and earned five or six dollars a night; he credits Gabriel with his start.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
